title: Waimea Valley Waterfall Swim & Dole Plantation Tour with Lunch
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the rich culture and natural beauty of Waimea Valley on this guided waterfall tour. Enjoy a scenic hike through tropical gardens and ancient Hawaiian sites, followed by a refreshing swim at the base of Waimea Falls. Along the way, your guide will share fascinating insights into Hawaiian history and local ecology. The tour also includes coffee and a light breakfast at Green World Coffee Farm, a healthy lunch at Waimea Valley, and a visit to Dole Plantation - the perfect blend of nature, culture, and fun!
